## ce40117f40f9

**Classification: reproduced contract weaknesses; suspected spatial shortcut.**

Checked 300 default draws, four concrete malformed/degenerate inputs, one explicit
axis request, and actual reference execution on the degenerate cases. Source
SHA256 is `d312592c8a155e0b847eb48b5b67805ceca01ff7ac2d526b8cff00ef4e7f849e`.

The task moves a non-marker blob to a color-9 destination. Yet an 8x8 all-zero
grid returns `self_check == []`. An 8x9 grid with color-4 cells at (1,1), (1,2),
and (2,1), but no marker, also passes. A marker-only grid with 9 at (5,6) passes.
The retained marker-on-blob case also passes. Coordinates are zero-based. Actual
Racket execution returns grids on these inputs rather than raising an exception:
blank stays blank, marker-only and no-marker examples are identities, and the
marker-on-blob case removes the marker. This is a domain-guard weakness, not a
claim that Racket crashes or that these degenerate cases appear by default.

`generate(0, 0, blob_size=6)` returns a three-cell blob and a clean self-check:
the request is silently ignored. The generator should either implement this axis
or reject unsupported/out-of-domain requests explicitly, rather than making its
control behavior misleading. Exact grid and measurements are in
`audits.ce40117f40f9.cases.ignored_blob_size`.

All 300 default draws contain both required entities, and all 300 destinations
are strictly down and right of the blob. This supports a **suspected coverage gap**:
a learner might rely on quadrant position instead of interpreting the marker.
It does not prove that any sampled default label is wrong, nor establish a fully
canonical-consistent executable spatial rival. Recommended follow-up is lawful
up/left/mixed-direction translation examples with clipping-safe placement and
explicit missing-entity rejection. No source fix is included for this audit.

## ce40117f40f9

**Reproduced contract and validator defects; possible spatial shortcut.** The
audited source SHA-256 was
`d312592c8a155e0b847eb48b5b67805ceca01ff7ac2d526b8cff00ef4e7f849e`.
The task's `self_check` returned no errors for a blank grid, a blob with no
marker, a marker with no blob, and a grid containing a Boolean cell. An unknown
`not_an_axis=123` override was silently accepted and produced the default grid.
The advertised `blob_size=6` override produced only three non-marker cells and
still passed `self_check`. These are reproduced defects, not merely suspected
style issues; the exact calls and grids are in
`checks/audit/ce40117f40f9/probe.json`.

Across 100 default draws in each of easy, medium, and hard (300 total), every
valid scene placed the marker strictly down and right of the entire blob. That
makes “find the only separated cell southeast of the blob” a possible
position-specific shortcut; this bounded census does not prove that the rule is
wrong. The selected Racket authority, hash `28f814e6d694`, executed the malformed
blank/no-marker/marker-only examples rather than rejecting them
(`checks/audit/ce40117f40f9/racket.json`), so validation must carry the domain
contract. No source was changed.

## ce40117f40f9

**Classification: reproduced defect plus reproduced shortcut.** Source was not changed.

Source binding: `generators/ce40117f40f9/generator.py`, version `2.0.1`, SHA-256 `d312592c8a155e0b847eb48b5b67805ceca01ff7ac2d526b8cff00ef4e7f849e`.

The current `self_check` returns no reasons for five malformed/domain-breaking cases: an all-zero grid, a blob with no marker, a marker with no blob, and a valid-looking case whose first cell is boolean `True` (the probe also retains the exact grids). An unknown override is accepted and produces the same grid as the default. The advertised `blob_size=6` override is also accepted but emits only three non-marker blob cells for the retained call. These are generator/validator contract defects, so no Racket disagreement is needed to reproduce them.

A deterministic default scan used sample indices 0–99 in each of easy, medium, and hard (300/300 successful calls). Every case contained one marker and one blob, and every marker lay strictly southeast of the blob. That leaves a positional shortcut independent of the intended shape relation. The exact rows and denominator are in `checks/audit/current/ce40117f40f9/probe.json`; the source-bound driver is `checks/audit/reproduce_audits.py` and manifest is `checks/audit/current/manifest.json`.

Scope limit: this audit checked the Python generator contract and 300 default draws; it did not prove that every lawful input or every seed has the positional bias. The target needs a separate owner to strengthen `self_check`, reject unknown/ignored controls, and diversify relative placement.
